item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00109","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C24","C25"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 supplies the same concrete Department of Defense succession machinery used by the child: activation upon the Secretary of Defense's absence, designation of an officer to act as Secretary, and temporary service without displacement of the officer's statutory position. The child's express reliance on Part V of a succession directive reinforces this unusually specific structural connection. C24 is the next-strongest language analogue because it combines temporary service during an incumbent's absence with termination upon appointment of a Deputy, while C25 is an earlier, substantially identical Defense succession framework.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"In the event of the absence of the Secretary of Defense ... you are ... designated to act as Secretary of Defense","parent_excerpt":"In the event of the death, disability, or absence of the Secretary of Defense, the following designated officers ... shall succeed to the position of, and act as, Secretary of Defense","explanation":"The child closely adapts C08's triggering condition, office, and acting-secretary mechanism to an individual designation."},{"child_excerpt":"during the next thirty days or until the appointment of a Deputy Secretary of Defense pursuant to law","parent_excerpt":"Succession to office pursuant to this order shall be on a temporary or Interim basis","explanation":"Both establish expressly temporary succession rather than a permanent transfer of office."},{"child_excerpt":"under the provisions of Part V of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... designated to act as Secretary of Defense","parent_excerpt":"Part V  Succession to office pursuant to this order shall be on a temporary or Interim basis and shall not have the effect of vacating the statutory position held by the successor.","explanation":"The child's reliance on a Part V succession provision closely matches C08's distinctive organization and legal machinery."}]}
